items.title: 5 of JP Morgan’s Top Stock Picks Pay Big Dividends and One Yields Over 12%
items.summary: J.P. Morgan updates its Analyst Focus List every month, and the August edition quietly signals where the firm's top analysts are placing their highest-conviction bets, including a handful of dividend payers that could surprise income investors hunting for yield in a market trading near all-time highs.

items.title: 3 Quantum Computing Stocks With the Most Upside in August
items.summary: White House quantum executive orders just handed the sector a fresh tailwind, yet not every stock is riding it the same way. Three names are flashing analyst-implied upside that ranges from compelling to jaw-dropping, and the gap between hype and fundamentals has never been wider.

items.title: Supreme Court rejects Verizon bid to recover $47M FCC fine
items.summary: The court denied Verizon's petition without explanation, ending the carrier's effort to recover a fine over the sale of customer location data

items.title: It’s August and 5 High-Yield S&P 500 Dividend Stocks Are Back-to-School Bargains
items.summary: Wall Street analysts are flagging five S&P 500 dividend stocks as deeply undervalued right now, and the window to buy them at these prices may not stay open long into the fall.

items.title: Supreme Court rejects Verizon effort to get $46.9M FCC fine refund in location data case
items.summary: Verizon's $46.9 million FCC penalty remains in place after the Supreme Court denied rehearing in a dispute over customer location data and jury-trial rights.

items.title: How much to invest in AT&T stock for $1,000 in annual dividends
items.summary: See how many AT&T shares it takes to earn $1,000 a year in dividends, plus the payout ratio and cash flow numbers behind the payment.

items.title: The Unusual Cash Offer Sitting In T Stock
items.summary: The market is offering one of America's largest communications companies at a steep discount, but the price tag comes with a critical question about its path to growth.

items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $75,000 Salary With Dividends?
items.summary: The yield you chase to replace a salary can quietly destroy the purchasing power you built to protect. Before you settle on a number, understand what the tradeoff between yield and dividend growth actually costs you over a decade.
